;''Logical Language Group (LLG)''
: The Logical Language Group is legally in charge of the development and maintenance of [[Lojban]]. It also works to promote the use of Lojban throughout the world.

<noinclude>[[File:lojban_logo_cizra.svg|thumb|link=]]The Logical Language Group, Inc. is a non-profit organization meant to serve the needs of the [[Lojban]] community. It can be [[Contact Us|contacted by various means]], both online and off.

The Logical Language Group is also called "[[la lojbangirz|la .lojbangirz.]]" (/lah-lozh-BAHN-geerz./), its [[Lojban]] name. It is frequently referred to with the abbreviation [[LLG|LLG]]. It was founded informally in 1987, and incorporated in 1988. The U. S. Internal Revenue Service approved its status as a 501(c)(3) non-profit educational/scientific charity in 1989, making donations and grants to the organization deductible under U. S. tax law.  LLG materials on this site are provided on a "[[LLG Web Copyright License|use with attribution]]" basis.

One will frequently hear the term [[Lojban Central|Lojban Central]], which refers to the leadership of the LLG, perceived (rightly or wrongly) as leading the language, and language development in particular.
